newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sacks national intelligence service chief.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sacks national intelligence service chief.

text.p: Bulgarian President Petar Stoyanov dismissed the chief of the National Intelligence Service, Brigo Asparuhov on Thursday, as part of a restructuring, a presidency spokeswoman said.
The spokeswoman said Stoyanov had signed a decree dismissing Asparuhov after the cabinet approved a proposal by the defence minister.

The cabinet proposed to replace Asparuhov with Dimo Gyaurov, a deputy of the Union of Democratic Forces, the main opposition party in the parliament dissolved last month. General elections are due on April 19.
Gyaurov's appointment must also be approved by Stoyanov.
The interim cabinet which took office on February 13 has sacked a number of senior officials appointed by the former Socialist government.
